dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Claude Sonnet 4.5 matched or exceeded all its predecessors in the end-to-end evaluation of both virology tasks, achieving a “max of 5” score of 0.89 for virology task 1

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Overall, Claude Sonnet 4.5 was clearly the best model on capture-the-flag challenges to date, including Claude Opus 4.1.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Claude Sonnet 4.5 achieved a score of 0.514, slightly outperforming Claude Opus 4.1’s score of 0.507
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D results and rule-out thresholds

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: on influence operations, Claude Sonnet 4.5 reliably refused to generate potentially deceptive or manipulative scaled abuse techniques including the creation of sockpuppet personas or astroturfing
dc_eval_persuasion.note: qualitative finding from a named evaluation on influence operations; no dedicated persuasion capability eval

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Claude Sonnet 4.5 took deceptive actions twice with extended thinking off and never with extended thinking on.
dc_eval_scheming.note: also sandbagging, SHADE-Arena, eval awareness, reward hacking results

framework_threshold.quote: Remained well below ASL-4 thresholds across all domains of concern;
framework_threshold.note: ASL-3 required, ASL-4 ruled out under the Responsible Scaling Policy

ext_test_any.quote: We shared late pre-deployment snapshots of Claude Sonnet 4.5 with two organizations that are building up specialized functions for model behavior evaluation

ext_test_named_org.note: Apollo Research and UK AISI named

ext_test_government.quote: UK AISI was given access to [an early snapshot of Claude Sonnet 4.5] on September 22nd

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: We shared late pre-deployment snapshots of Claude Sonnet 4.5

safeguards_training.quote: we implemented a new safety training pipeline for mitigating harmlessness consisting of specification updates, revamped data pipelines, and retooled algorithms

safeguards_runtime.quote: we deploy real-time classifier systems that monitor and detect potential prompt injections—across MCP, computer use, and tool use—enabling us to halt an attack before it executes its harmful instructions
safeguards_runtime.note: also monitoring for malicious coding activity (4.1.2)

safeguards_access.note: No trusted-access, KYC or safety-tied usage restriction found. Developer Mode via Sales (1.1.2) is not tied to safety. Keywords checked by grep.

safeguards_weights.note: Card says ASL-3 Security Standard was met (9.3.1) but never states it protects this model's weights; only the ASL-4 standard is described as protecting against weight theft, a stricter standard not applied. Exfiltration appears only as evaluated behaviour. Ambiguous.
